import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')

p = prev.groupby(['cloud_service','instance_family']).unblended_cost.mean()
c = cur.groupby(['cloud_service','instance_family']).unblended_cost.sum()
comp = pd.DataFrame({'prev_avg':p,'oct16':c}).fillna(0)
comp['diff']=comp.oct16-comp.prev_avg
print(comp.sort_values('diff',ascending=False).head(20))

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
a = df[df.account_id=='JUNpaMa'].copy()

z=[]
for fam,g in stats.groupby('instance_family'):
    s=g.set_index('date').unblended_cost
    m=s.drop(pd.Timestamp('2025-10-16'))
    mu,sd=m.mean(),m.std()
    v=s.get(pd.Timestamp('2025-10-16'),np.nan)
    z.append((fam,mu,sd,(v-mu)/sd if sd else 0,v))
for r in sorted(z,key=lambda x:-abs(x[3]))[:10]: print(r)

    v=s.get(pd.Timestamp('2025-10-16'),0)
